from math import sinh

schema T scope logical:
    entity_id: String key
    z: Float mutable
    one: Float mutable
    two: Float mutable
    three: Float mutable
    half: Float mutable
    big: Float mutable

rule sinh_pos_zero_is_pos_zero:
    T t where (sinh(t.z) == 0.0) and ((1.0 / sinh(t.z)) is inf)
->
    log info "a"

rule sinh_neg_zero_is_neg_zero:
    T t where (sinh(-t.z) == 0.0) and ((1.0 / sinh(-t.z)) is -inf)
->
    log info "b"

rule sinh_pos_inf_is_pos_inf:
    T t where sinh(t.big * t.big) is inf
->
    log info "c"

rule sinh_neg_inf_is_neg_inf:
    T t where sinh(-(t.big * t.big)) is -inf
->
    log info "d"
